study type: Case series with a cross-sectional component
outcome: Diagnosis of Niemann-Pick disease type A (NPD-A)
Diagnosis of Niemann-Pick disease type B (NPD-B)
Specific SMPD1 gene variants (e.g., c.1343A>G p.Tyr448Cys, c.1829_1831delGCC p.Arg610del, c.1547A>G p.His516Arg, c.1805G>A p.Arg602His, c.1263+8C>T)
Heterozygous carrier status for SMPD1 pathogenic variants
cohort: The study included four unrelated female pediatric patients between 1 and 7 years of age diagnosed with NPD-A or NPD-B, and a control group of 50 unrelated healthy Mexican Mestizos.
finding: The study identified specific known and novel SMPD1 gene variants and their correlations with NPD-A/B phenotypes in four patients, and detected a heterozygous pathogenic carrier frequency of 1/50 in healthy Mexican Mestizos.
